style: Compact Mir Ghat temple with a polychrome Dravidian gateway
key_structures: Polychrome street gopura in the residential gali
Gajalakshmi and elephant lintel, floral frame and flanking lions
Small mandapa, inner sanctuary, and circumambulatory passage
Kala Bhairava and Navagraha in the mandapa and Shiva with Nandi around the sanctuary
special_features: Two images of Vishalakshi share the sanctuary
Nagarathar Tamil wall lettering beside the entrance
materials: Yellow plaster and painted sculptural relief
period: Historic sacred site within the living Mir Ghat neighbourhood
renovation_history: The Indian Institute of Heritage documents Tamil patronage of the 1971 renovation. The Nagarathar dedication is visible beside the entrance.
